items.t: FedEx holds at 5.9% for a fourth straight year
items.body: FedEx set a 5.9% average increase for 2027, its fourth 5.9% headline in a row after 2024, 2025 and 2026. UPS also used 5.9% for 2024, 2025 and 2026; its 2027 increase had not been announced as of early October. Both carriers were at 4.9% from 2018 through 2021 and 6.9% in 2023.

items.t: Size rules tightened at all three carriers in 2025-2026
items.body: FedEx began rounding every fraction of an inch up for dimensional weight on Aug. 18, 2025. FedEx (Jan. 12, 2026) and UPS (Jan. 26, 2026) added cubic-volume triggers to Additional Handling at 10,368 cubic inches and to Oversize and Large Package at 17,280 cubic inches. USPS cut its dimensional divisor from 166 to 139 on July 12, 2026.

items.t: USPS now changes parcel prices more than once a year
items.body: USPS has added a mid-year shipping price change every year since 2023, on top of its January change. In 2026 it also applied a temporary 8% increase on Priority Mail, Ground Advantage, Priority Mail Express and Parcel Select from April 26, which runs with the holiday peak prices until Jan. 17, 2027.

FedEx's 2026 residential demand charge reaches $0.80 per package in the peak window, up from $0.65 in 2025; Ground Economy reaches $4.05, from $3.55. UPS's peak Large Package charge tops out at $117.50 in 2026, up from $107 in 2025, and its Over Maximum Limits charge at $590, from $540.
